Stop showing a notification

## Synopsis

Stop showing a notification.

Pass the ID shown in the notification's heading, such as 3fa in WARNING [ID: 3fa]. To hide every notification, set PULUMI_HIDE_NOTIFICATIONS=true.

```
pulumi notifications dismiss <id-prefix> [flags]
```

